blocks.html: The city of Richardson is located in northern Texas within Dallas and Collin Counties. Richardson is a suburb of Dallas with a population of approximately 120,000 people as of 2020. While Richardson encompasses only 28 square miles, more than 5000 businesses operate within the city limits, including many of the world’s largest telecommunications companies such as Cisco Systems, Verizon, AT&T, Texas Instruments, and Samsung. Also, Geico, United Healthcare, and State Farm Insurance all have regional hub offices in Richardson. The median household income in Richardson is just under $86,000, with property values exceeding $275,000. The current poverty rate in Richardson is almost 11%.

blocks.html: Richardson experiences many of the same challenges related to drug and alcohol addiction as are seen at the county and state levels. Within Dallas County, 8 and 14 of every 100,000 deaths are related to alcohol or drug use, respectively. Almost 50% of all motor vehicle fatalities are connected to drunk driving. Within Collin County in 2019, 19% of or nearly 1/5 of the adult population in the county reported binge or heavy drinking. The Dallas-Fort Worth Healthcare Foundation reports indicate that between 2016 and 2018, the death rate for drug overdoses was 227 deaths per 100,000.
